source.title: Report and Analysis of the P.R. Urban Elections in Ulster held on 15 January 1920 (Ulster Committee of the Proportional Representation Society of Ireland, 1920), Woodvale Ward results sheet; reprinted in PR Urban Elections in Ulster, 1920 (Electoral Reform Society, London, 1972), pp. 34-35
source.publisher: Proportional Representation Society of Ireland (Ulster Committee); reprinted by the Electoral Reform Society of Great Britain and Ireland
source.check: every stage transcribed by eye from the printed results sheet; every count adds to the printed valid vote, each result is the previous result plus the printed transfer, the quota is the valid vote divided by one more than the seats, plus one

note: First election by proportional representation (single transferable vote) under the Local Government (Ireland) Act 1919, on the nine wards that replaced the fifteen of 1896. Polled 15 January 1920 and counted on 16 and 17 January. The ward returned 7 members: 2 aldermen and 5 councillors.
sourceNote: The results sheet prints Twaddell's first preferences as 572, but 572 plus his printed transfer of 239 is not his printed 812, and the first count then adds to 11,244 against the printed 11,245; 573 is used. The electorate is from the ward scheme table in Part One of the report.
